card.name: Radiation dose units and mouse assays
card.fires_on: Responds to radiation-dose unit pieces such as m, r or digits before rad, mrad, mGy or mSv in dosimetry tables. Also responds to the word mouse in genotoxicity test names.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: Start of a unit or a digit inside a radiation absorbed-dose expression like mrad/mCi or mGy/MBq.

modes.label: Mouse in assay names
modes.description: The word mouse in mutagenicity test names such as mouse lymphoma or mouse dominant lethal assay.

card.plain: It lights up on radiation dose units in dosimetry tables and on mouse in lab toxicity test names.
